title: Make retryable failure marker clears available from Reports
summary: Fix Reports failure rows where retryable Will retry statuses can be shown without a working marker clear action.
reason: Operators need to clear active retryable failure markers through the backend command path when the root cause has been handled; row-level clear controls should not silently become unusable for retryable failure rows with marker evidence.
behavior_before: Retryable latest-failure rows could display Will retry while the Clear error control remained disabled or ineffective when marker matching evidence was incomplete.
behavior_after: Retryable Reports failure rows can match active markers by source path or per-file job/stage/error evidence, and successful marker clears switch the view to active failure markers so stale latest-report rows do not make the clear look ineffective.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_maintenance_reports_smoke.WebViewBrowserMaintenanceReportsSmoke.test_real_browser_renders_maintenance_reports_and_clear_error_payloads - failed before failure-clear assertions: unrelated Reports audit score-policy assertion
pytest targeted failure/report tests - blocked: bundled Python has no pytest module
rollback_plan: Revert the failure preview/WebView clear changes and focused tests. Existing backend marker cleanup safeguards and media files remain untouched.
